seo.metaTitle: Royal Orchard Multan Map — Master Plan of Blocks A to G on Satellite
seo.metaDescription: Royal Orchard Multan master plan on the satellite map: Blocks A to G, the Royal Boulevard, the mosque, hospital, parks, schools and the gates on MPS Road and Shakh-e-Madina Road.
seo.intro: Royal Orchard Multan master plan — Blocks A, B, C, D, E, F and G, the Royal Boulevard from the MPS Road gate to Shakh-e-Madina Road, the central roundabout and grand mosque, the hospital, theme park, community club, parks and schools — the society's own plan laid on the satellite map. See the properties listed in Royal Orchard and find a plot on site with your live location.
seo.content: This is Royal Orchard's published master plan; the society office confirms the exact position of a plot. For a plot's final location, check with the office at Gate 1, Multan Public School Road (UAN 061-111-444-475).

faqs.q: Which blocks are in Royal Orchard Multan?
faqs.a: Seven blocks: A, C and E west of the Royal Boulevard, and B, D, F and G east of it.

faqs.q: Where are the gates of Royal Orchard Multan?
faqs.a: The main gate is on Multan Public School Road at the south end of the Royal Boulevard; the boulevard runs north to Shakh-e-Madina Road.

faqs.q: Where is the mosque in Royal Orchard Multan?
faqs.a: The grand mosque is beside the central roundabout, where the Royal Boulevard meets Iqbal Boulevard, on the Block E side.
